coverage.main: Read all fourteen pages of arXiv 1912.11969 (CVPR 2020 content): Sections 1-8, Tables 1-9, Figures 1-8, references and the appendix (implementation details, visualisations, Table 9, Figure 8). The CVPR open-access version was not retrieved separately.
coverage.supplement: The appendix is embedded in the arXiv PDF and read.
coverage.excluded_results: Tables 3-9 and Figure 6 are white-box robustness evaluations of adversarially trained models (PGD, M-PGD, CW on the evaluated model) and training-time comparisons. Figure 3 measures the attack loss of accumulated perturbations on the current model. The paper states that it does not use black-box attacks beyond the Section 3.1 analysis.

result_groups.population: MNIST and CIFAR-10 examples (split and number not stated); adversarial examples from intermediate epoch models T1-T3 or independently seeded models S1-S3 transferred to an adversarially trained target T
result_groups.outcome: error-rate transferability: ratio of the number of adversarial examples misclassified by the source to that misclassified by the target; loss transferability ratio (graphical)
result_groups.evidence: A ratio of source and target misclassification counts over an unstated common set; no clean-correct or source-success rule is stated.

f1.evidence: Natural accuracies are reported for the adversarially trained models in the white-box evaluation tables, but not for the Figure 1 source and target models.

f3.evidence: The ratio metric counts source and target misclassifications separately; no filter is stated.

f5.evidence: Section 5.1 states L-infinity 0.3/0.031 for training and evaluation, but the Section 3.1 transfer attack parameters are not given.

f6.evidence: Code is linked (github.com/hzzheng93/ATTA) for ATTA training; its coverage of the Figure 1 analysis was not verified.

artifact_checks.result: Repository linked in the paper; not cloned or executed; coverage of the Section 3.1 transfer analysis not established.

bounds_checks.reason: A ratio of misclassification counts is not a transferred misclassification probability, and no clean baseline is given.

limitations: Non-blind evidence audit. The paper's main contribution is adversarial training; only the Figure 1 motivation analysis is a cross-model transfer scope.
